Practi- cally insoluble in water; slightly soluble in alcohol; sparingly sol- uble or slightly soluble in methyl alcohol. Profile Brotizolam is a short-acting benzodiazepine with general proper- ties similar to those of diazepam (p.986). It is given for the short- term (up to 2 weeks) management of insomnia (p.957) in usual oral doses of 250 micrograms at night. The suggested dose for elderly and debilitated patients is 125 micrograms. Abuse. Reference to abuse of brotizolam in Germany and Hong Kong.1 1. WHO.
